description: Crawls up to 25 pages of one website (same host only) and reports the problems an SEO or QA check looks for: broken links (up to 40 outbound links spot-checked per page), missing page titles and meta descriptions, slow pages over 1.5 seconds, and pages over 500 KB. Returns a summary of issues plus per-page details as JSON. Has a 45-second time limit and polite pacing. Every URL is fetched through a public-internet-only safe fetcher. Paid only: $0.50 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/site-audit.
name: site-audit
